content.rendered:
Picture day has arrived. Students in person learning will have their picture taken during the school day and cloud students will be photographed at their home school in the afternoon. Cloud students with last names beginning with A-J 1:30-1:50 and students with last names ending K-Z will be photographed 1:50-2:10. Photos will be taken in the school cafeteria.

Order forms are being sent home this week or you can place your order online here with Dorian Studio.

Due to the timing of our photos this year Dorian will be unable to provide retake photos during the school day/year. Retakes will only be available in studio and you can make an appointment directly with Dorian Studio.
